msg.disableConfirm: Disable platform [{0}]? Registration task will stop and logout request will be sent.
msg.refreshConfirm: Refresh registration scheduler? All enabled platforms will be reloaded.
msg.deleteConfirm: Delete platform [{0}]? Ensure it's disabled and has no associated channel mappings.
msg.platformIdFormat: Platform ID must be 20-digit GB28181 format
msg.clientMissing: No local client available yet. Create one on the Local Client page first.

placeholder.platformName: Enter platform name (optional, for local identification)
placeholder.clientRefId: Select a local client (code and advertised IP come from it)

placeholder.clientIp: Enter an IP the upstream can reach back (blank = fill with the bound address when enabling)

help.page: A local client is the identity this node registers with upstream: 20-digit platform code plus the Contact header IP. Cascade platforms reference it, so changing the IP once takes effect everywhere.

msg.clientIdFormat: Local platform code must be 20 digits
msg.deleteConfirm: Delete local client [{0}]? Referenced platforms will block the deletion.

empty.noClient: No local client yet: create one before referencing this identity on a cascade platform

platformView.title: Platform view: organizations in the upstream catalog
platformView.readOnlyTip: Read-only: this is the upstream catalog at this moment. Switch back to the local view to make changes.
platformView.rerouted: {0} with channels rerouted to the domain node
platformView.treeTitle: Organizations in catalog (as upstream sees them)
platformView.treeEmpty: No organization in this platform catalog yet
platformView.blockedTitle: Checked for publishing, but invisible upstream
platformView.blockedEmpty: No blocker: every checked organization is already in the catalog
platformView.blockedTip: These organizations are checked for publishing but blocked by the node listed; fix the blocker and the next catalog snapshot will include them.
platformView.note: Codes and names are shown with this platform overrides; differing from local values is expected.

effective.blocked: An ancestor is disabled, so this node is invisible on every platform

placeholder.platformIds: Optional, can be configured later in "Published To"

help.create: The org code is generated by the backend and cannot be typed in; the parent decides its place in the tree.
help.parentId: The parent cannot be changed directly; use "Move to..." instead. The code stays, but every platform rebuilds the subtree.
help.platformIds: Only decides which platforms receive it right away; unchecking never deletes configuration.
help.enabled: Disabling removes the whole subtree from every platform catalog, without deleting any data.
help.deleteRule: Deletion requires: no child organizations and no bound channels. A reported organization is first revoked from the upstream catalog and deleted locally only after the upstream platform confirms.

msg.deleteConfirm: Delete organization [{0}]? Its report is revoked from every upstream platform first and the record is deleted only after they confirm. This cannot be undone.
msg.deleteBlockedChannels: This organization still has {0} channel(s); move them first
msg.publishSuccess: Organization re-enabled; the node and its subtree reappear on every platform

revoke.title: Disable Organization
revoke.nodes: Nodes removed from each platform catalog
revoke.previewFailed: Failed to preview impact. Do not disable before reviewing the numbers.
revoke.deliverRisk: Messages cannot be delivered now; the disable will not take effect upstream
revoke.policyHint: Channel policy is configured per platform in "Published To"; shown here for reference.
revoke.batchTip: {0} organization(s) selected. They run one by one; results are listed per organization.
revoke.dataKept: Local data of organizations and channels is kept; you can re-enable anytime.
revoke.nothingToRevoke: Select organizations to disable (already disabled ones can be skipped)

empty.noPlatformTip: Which platform receives an organization is decided by publish settings. Create a platform first.
empty.noOrgTip: Channels only appear under a business group when attached to an organization. Build a tree by region/project.

move.title: Move Organization
move.placeholder: Leave empty to move to root
move.hint: The current organization and all its descendants are disabled in the list; choosing one would detach the subtree.
move.warning: Platforms do not migrate existing nodes: the old parents are deleted one by one, then the subtree is rebuilt under the new parent. Codes and channel bindings stay, but the subtree is re-created upstream and related group configuration may need to be redone.
move.dataKept: Only the parent and org path change locally; no child organization or channel binding is deleted.

publish.title: Published To · {0}
publish.tip: Checked means the organization is published to that platform. Unchecking keeps code/name overrides; re-check to publish again.
publish.revokePolicyTip: When the organization is invisible on this platform, its channels are either removed or re-attached to the domain node.

code.title: Recompute Codes · {0}
code.loading: Previewing against the current code rule...
code.warning: Saving deletes these nodes upstream under their old codes first, then re-publishes the whole subtree under the new codes. Group configuration already set on the platform may need to be redone.
code.channelKept: Channel codes stay unchanged: once published they are the reference key for upstream recordings, subscriptions and playback.
code.disabledTip: The global switch gateway.cascade.code-rule.enabled or this organization's "generate by rule" is off; nothing will be written.
code.conflictTitle: Code conflicts found, nothing was written
code.conflictTip: The new code is already used by another object on the same platform. All conflicts are listed at once; fix them and preview again.
code.noChange: Organization codes already follow the rule
code.previewFailed: Preview failed. Avoid running without seeing the change list.

rule.badgeTip: This organization uses the 7-segment code rule for creation and recompute
rule.enabledHelp: When on, the code is built from the segments below. Saving never changes an already published code; run "Recompute Codes" to apply the new segments. Has no effect while gateway.cascade.code-rule.enabled is off.
rule.startSeqHelp: Lower bound of the number pool only; 0 or empty means no bound. Sequence is still max+1 across all codes with the same prefix.
rule.invalidWidth: Each segment must be {0} digit(s); leave empty to inherit from the parent

tip.level: Level is derived from the org path and supports arbitrary nesting
tip.channelCount: Direct channels only, excluding child organizations

push.title: Push Settings
push.localTip: Code, name and publishing switch are per-platform values; only the local state affects every platform. The parent node follows local organization assignment.
push.enabledTip: Turning it off sends a delete message upstream; the configuration is kept.
push.removeConfirm: The channel will no longer be published to this platform and code/name overrides are discarded. Continue?

assign.title: Organization
assign.orgTip: A channel follows its device: its place in the catalog is decided by the device's organization. Change the device, and every platform follows.

batchBind.title: Batch Push
batchBind.platformTip: Multi-select: each platform gets its own push config, independent of the others.
batchBind.checkedTip: {0} channel(s) checked; switch to "By organization" to push a whole subtree.
batchBind.orgTip: Pushes every channel of the devices under this organization (channel placement follows the device); turn off to push direct devices only.
batchBind.help: Publish code defaults to the local channel code. Use per-row "Push Settings" to override.
batchBind.resultSummary: {0} channel(s) × {1} platform(s): {2} created, {3} already reporting, {4} stopped
batchBind.resultDisabledTip: Stopped rows are not re-enabled by a batch push; use per-row "Push Settings" to restore.
batchBind.resultNothing: Nothing was pushed: check that the organization has channels and that their org is published to the target platform.

help.page: The list is the local channel ledger; each row's "Push Settings" maintains per-platform code, name, switch and parent override.

msg.localDisableConfirm: Disabling channel [{0}] removes it from all platform catalogs (data kept). Continue?
msg.deleteConfirm: Deleting channel [{0}] first revokes its report (drop the push settings on every platform and remove the catalog node); the local record is deleted only after the upstream platforms confirm. This cannot be undone. Continue?

empty.noChannel: No local channels. Sync channels on the device page first.

monitor.title: Cascade Runtime Status
monitor.name: Runtime Status
monitor.help: Everything here is in-memory transient state: which page the catalog is stuck on, whether any page is in flight, and which SN the upstream currently subscribes to.

tip.refreshInterval: Refreshes every 5 seconds, paused while the page is hidden

subscribe.title: Subscription Detail
subscribe.empty: No active subscription for this platform
